import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Curated from primary literature reviewed (PMIDs noted). cDNA/protein as reported.
variants = [
    # protein, type, phenotype_category, pmid
    ("p.Ile342Ser","missense","cataract+hypotrichosis/PPKCA","37947113/37455568/35413293/41442087"),
    ("p.Gly99Asp","missense","cataract+hypotrichosis","37947113"),
    ("p.Thr228Ile","missense","mutilating PPK","36811447"),
    ("p.Arg260His","missense","mutilating PPK","36811447"),
    ("p.Asp170Asn","missense","hypotrichosis+pseudoainhum","40237410"),
    ("p.Ile323Thr","missense","non-syndromic hypotrichosis","37029088"),
    ("p.Gly600Val","missense","non-syndromic hypotrichosis","37029088"),
    ("p.Ser339Leu","missense","APMR4 (ID/cataract)","37659595"),
    ("p.Gly508Arg","missense","APMR4 (ID/cataract)","37659595"),
    ("p.Gly508Trp","missense","PPKCA2","35413293"),
    ("p.Val537Leu","missense","APMR4","36251212"),
    ("p.Arg129Gln","missense","hypotrichosis simplex","41442087"),
    ("p.Arg129Trp","missense","hypotrichosis simplex","41442087"),
    ("p.Gly352Arg","missense","hypotrichosis simplex","41442087"),
    ("p.Glu532Gln","missense","hypotrichosis simplex","41442087"),
    ("p.Arg435Cys","missense","hypotrichosis simplex","41442087"),
    ("p.Arg663Trp","missense","hypotrichosis 14","40696433"),
    ("p.Trp581Arg","missense","congenital cataract","26200341"),
    ("p.Gly588Ser","missense","congenital cataract","26200341"),
    ("p.Thr446Tyrfs*10","frameshift","hypotrichosis simplex","41442087"),
    ("p.Pro68Argfs*14","frameshift","hypotrichosis 14","40696433"),
    ("p.Leu511Phefs*17","frameshift","cataract+hypotrichosis","37455568"),
    ("p.Arg328*","nonsense","hypotrichosis 14","40696433"),
    ("p.His307del","inframe_del","hypotrichosis 14","40696433"),
    ("p.Glu469del","inframe_del","hypotrichosis 14","40696433"),
    ("p.Met1?","start_loss","PPKCA2","35413293"),
    ("c.428+42T>A","splice","PPKCA2","35413293"),
    ("c.893-175G>A","deep_intronic_splice","hypotrichosis simplex","41442087"),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(variants, columns=["variant","type","phenotype","pmid"])
print("Total curated reported LSS alleles:", len(df))
print(df["type"].value_counts())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,5))
vc = df["type"].value_counts()
ax[0].bar(vc.index, vc.values, color="steelblue")
ax[0].set_title("Reported LSS variant types (curated, n=%d)"%len(df))
ax[0].set_ylabel("count"); ax[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=40)
for i,v in enumerate(vc.values): ax[0].text(i, v+0.1, str(v), ha='center')

# simplify phenotype categories
def cat(p):
    p=p.lower()
    if "cataract" in p and "hypotrichosis" in p: return "cataract+hair"
    if "cataract" in p: return "cataract"
    if "apmr" in p: return "APMR4 (ID)"
    if "ppk" in p or "pseudoainhum" in p: return "PPK/keratoderma"
    return "isolated hypotrichosis"
df["pcat"]=df["phenotype"].map(cat)
pc=df["pcat"].value_counts()
ax[1].barh(pc.index, pc.values, color="indianred")
ax[1].set_title("Associated phenotype category")
ax[1].set_xlabel("count of alleles")
for i,v in enumerate(pc.values): ax[1].text(v+0.1, i, str(v), va='center')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("lss_variant_spectrum.png", dpi=130)
print("\nMissense fraction: %.0f%%" % (100*(df['type']=='missense').mean()))
print("Figure saved: lss_variant_spectrum.png")
